patterns.note: Asymmetrical grid layouts are used for product displays, combining full-bleed imagery with smaller, varied aspect ratio images.
A striking contrast between oversized, elegant serif typography for display elements (like the hero overlay) and a clean, understated sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A sophisticated, muted palette of deep browns, off-whites, and subtle greys, allowing the rich textures and colors of the product photography to stand out.
The large hero text scrolls up and off-screen, while the background hero image scrolls with a subtle parallax effect, revealing content sections that fade or slide into view as the user scrolls down.
Editorial-style content blocks feature large, high-quality photography paired with concise text, often in a two-column layout that alternates image and text position.

technique_notes: The hero section features a large, custom-font text overlay that scrolls at a normal rate, while the full-bleed background image scrolls at a slightly slower rate, creating a subtle parallax effect. This transition reveals subsequent content sections.
A sticky header with a minimalist logo and navigation remains fixed at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll.

Content sections below the hero are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements fade in and subtly slide up as they enter the viewport, enhancing visual flow and engagement. This effect is likely orchestrated using a JavaScript library, potentially leveraging the detected webgl-three for more sophisticated transitions if applied beyond simple reveals.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~4-5x body) with generous letter spacing, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — very generous vertical spacing between sections and ample padding around content, creating a gallery-like feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extremely large, elegant serif typography as a primary visual element in the hero, combined with a sophisticated, muted color palette and high-end product photography, creates an immediate impression of luxury and curated artistry, setting it apart from typical e-commerce or portfolio sites.
